summary: Braskem S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing Brazilian CVM Resolution 44/2021 securities-trading disclosure forms under Article 11, covering October 2026 activity by board members, management, group/related persons and controlling shareholders, plus a consolidated form for Petrobras. Reported items include nominal tender-offer-to-acquire entries at R$9.24 per share, a spot sale of 146,200 Class A preferred shares at R$3.67, and small balances of Class A preferred shares and agribusiness receivables certificates. No corporate transaction, tender offer terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is announced; the filing is a periodic insider-dealing report with no special-situations event to trade.
